Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Poultry Pilafs are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]], [[Hylian Rice]], a [[Bird Egg]], and [[Goat Butter]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The Hylian Rice is sautéed in poultry broth, and the trick to making these [[Meal]]s is to cook them on low heat until the rice is fluffy. In [[Ivee's Diary]], Link can find a recipe for Poultry Pilaf.{{Cite|Today's Recipe:
{{Color BotW|Blue|Poultry Pilaf}}|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} [[Ivee]] lists the [[Ingredient]]s as a few Raw Bird Drumsticks, a little bit of Goat Butter, a suitable amount of Hylian Rice, and some Bird Eggs.{{Cite|Ingredients
{{Color BotW|Blue|Raw Bird Drumstick}} (just toss a few in)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Raw Bird Drumstick}} (actually, a few more)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Goat Butter}} (measure out "a little")
{{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian Rice}} (one "suitable amount")
{{Color BotW|Blue|Bird Eggs}} (a few should be fine)|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} She asserts that the accuracy of measurements does not matter, since it only adds to the flavor.{{Cite|Note: Inaccurate measurements only make the dish for de-lish!|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} Link can add a fifth Ingredient when making Poultry Pilaf, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. Eating these pilafs will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. Link gains one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Energizing Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Poultry Pilaf}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] can be partially refilled by eating these. * '''Enduring Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. Eating these pilafs will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. They can be eaten to boost Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, Link has all of his Hearts healed and gains [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredient. When eaten, they will increase the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredient. If consumed, Link will gain a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. These pilafs grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Tough Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Sautéed Hylian rice steamed in poultry broth. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. Eating them will boost Link's defensive abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Curry Pilaf * Food * Gourmet Poultry Pilaf * Meal * Prime Poultry Pilaf }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
